WHAT WE DO
We support strong founders and management teams with capital to further accelerate growth. CGC is an investment platform offering access to the Growth Private Equity asset class for individual as well as institutional investors.

We invest into proven business models alongside founders and other experienced investors in a partnership approach. We are funded by leading institutional investors including insurance companies, family offices and fund-of-funds. In addition, our investor base includes a network of 200+ high calibre individuals from the founder, corporate finance, investment and corporate community providing us with a unique network in our core region.

Our companies typically generate at least EUR 10 million of revenues with a technology-enabled superior business model, benefit from strong organic growth rates and a recurring revenue model as well as a strong base business with attractive unit economics. CGC can invest into influential minorities as well as majorities tailored to the requirements of the individual situation.

KEY PRINCIPLES
TECH-ENABLED BUSINESS MODELS

We believe that digitalization and technology will be a key driver for the sustainable success of any company. The recent pandemic has been a catalyst for disruption through tech-enabled business models and accelerated the transformation of traditional businesses.

SUPERIOR GROWTH

We believe that value generation can best be achieved through a combination of growth and cashflows. In accordance with this conviction we are building a balanced portfolio of disruptive proven companies as well as established businesses with strong transformational capabilities.

DACH FOCUS

Through our heritage as well as our investor and partner network, we have one the strongest networks in the DACH region. Consequently, we are focused on targets rooted in this region using our proprietary and early access to attractive companies.

PARTNERSHIP APPROACH

We believe in the symbiotic partnership between founders and managers on one side and investors on the other side. With a very high level of structuring flexibility we are guided by the principles of alignment of targets and incentives. We are backing strong founders and management teams who run businesses with best-in-class business models.

ESG

All of our investments promote environmental and social sustainability. We believe that an active and measurable ESG agenda promotes best in class environmental, social, and good governance practices which is key success factor for our portfolio companies.

WORKING AT CGC

We are looking to build out our team and are keen to meet talented people with an interest to work in a young, modern, and fast growing investment platform like ours. CGC focusses on investing in one of the most promising segments in the next decade and our firm is plugged into the DACH ecosystem of tech-enabled growing companies through our investors, employees, advisors as well as managers and partners in our portfolio companies.
